description: Client-side script for managing widget list interactions in OrchardCore CMS, including adding, inserting, deleting widgets, and toggling editor UI elements.

methods.name: add-list-widget click handler
methods.description: Handles adding new list widgets via AJAX and appending content to the DOM.

methods.name: insert-list-widget click handler
methods.description: Handles inserting list widgets before a target element via AJAX.

methods.name: widget-list-delete click handler
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a widget template, then triggers content preview re-render.

methods.name: widget-editor-footer change handler
methods.description: Triggers content preview re-render on footer label change.

methods.name: widget-list-editor-btn-toggle click handler
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of the widget editor UI.
